description: NYC Small Business Services certified business list (NYC Open Data): searches vendors by formal or trade name and returns certification, NAICS industry, city, website and renewal date. Public open data; owner contact and personal fields are excluded on purpose. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_nyc_business_licenses when you need NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection license; b2b_abr_australian_business_register when you need Australian Business Register, official register data: look. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
